title: Billing renders 'Manage billing' link from SHARED_CONFIG.billingPortalUrl; build, PR, deploy

summary: Added billingPortalUrl (https://homelab.local/billing/portal) to libs/shared-contracts SHARED_CONFIG; billing renders 'Manage billing' link from it. PR #1 merged, CI+CD green. Assumptions: 'shared configuration' = libs/shared-contracts (already holds billingUrl); no platformkit change needed since shared-contracts is inlined at build and billing deploys on apps/ change.
